cheat.title: The seven perspectives in one word each
Experiment vocabulary
items: IV = what the researcher changes. DV = what gets measured.
Experimental group gets the IV; control group doesn't.
Operational definitions → the study can be replicated.

cheat.title: Ethics checklist
items: Confidentiality, no long-term harm, humane treatment of animals, institutional approval.

cheat.title: Statistics quick rules
items: Mean = average; median = middle; mode = most common.
Range = highest − lowest. Bigger standard deviation = more spread.
Normal curve: about 68% within 1 SD, about 95% within 2 SD.
The mean follows the tail: positive skew → mean > median > mode.
p ≤ .05 = statistically significant; effect size = how strong.
Percentile rank = % of scores below yours.
